corporate.headline: Corporate events that run on time.
corporate.intro: Professional background music, seamless transitions between speeches and dancing, and a polished MC presence that represents your brand well.

features.title: Polished MC
features.text: Introductions, announcements and program flow, delivered with the right tone for your company.

features.title: Speeches, then the party
features.text: Background music while guests arrive, clean handoffs to speakers, and a dance floor when it's time.

features.title: Mics for every speaker
features.text: Wireless microphones included with larger packages, with extra pairs available.

features.title: Sound for big rooms
features.text: Pro sound with a subwoofer, and additional PA when the room needs it.

features.title: Clean, crowd-safe music
features.text: Every set stays clean and workplace-appropriate on request.

features.title: Branded photo booth
features.text: Add a digital photo booth with your logo and colors from Picture This Booth LA.
